output.subject: Thank you for your kind words about our Millbrook Plaza branch
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for taking the time to write to us. It is always a pleasure to receive a message like yours.

You told us that a member of our team at the Millbrook Plaza branch helped your mother with her new debit card, and that she was so patient she explained everything twice. You mentioned that this kind of care is something you don't see often anymore, and we really appreciate you letting us know when someone gets it right.

Patience matters, especially when getting used to something new, and it is lovely to hear that your mother felt supported during her visit. We hope her new card is serving her well.

We have received your message, and we would like to make sure your kind words reach the colleague you mentioned. If you or your mother ever need anything further, please don't hesitate to get in touch.

Thank you again for sharing this with us.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank

The staff member's name is redacted (⟦NAME_1⟧). Decide whether to name her in the reply, and confirm who she is before passing the feedback on.
The draft says we would like the praise to reach the colleague. Confirm this is appropriate, or soften it.
Consider whether to forward the compliment to the Millbrook Plaza branch manager or record it for staff recognition.
The customer made no request beyond recognising the staff member, and no follow-up action is needed for the customer or their mother.
